epistemicBoundaries: No specific parcel, titleholder, sponsor, campaign contributor, elected official or ordinance is identified by the two program totals.
LTTE and NJHMFA receipts are not ordinary property taxes and are not interchangeable with taxes abated.
NJHMFA tax abated is a reported amount, not proof of a direct fiscal loss, ordinary levy substitution, or local household burden.
Adding the two program receipts is an arithmetic subtotal for only the two reported programs, not a claim of all PILOTs.
Do not subtract PILOT receipts from reported taxes abated to imply an opportunity cost or calculate a developer windfall.
Underlying financial statements cover 2023–2024, not the 2025 rate-year comparison; do not imply the years are identical.
The AFS is labeled unaudited; audited notes reproduced in a municipal borrowing disclosure provide context. Retain source distinction.
Per-parcel financial agreements, public votes, and donation matches remain separately unresolved.
No person-level data or protected addresses are stored.
These aggregate observations are research inputs; live publication-gate assertions require independent editorial approval.
